scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:phone: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client -- --host"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
